njoy_documented_approximations.what: elastic onset uses a fixed edis = 25 eV: below the incident energy where the maximum recoil is 25 eV, W is taken as zero whatever `ed`
elastic W is evaluated on a 1.1-ratio energy ladder and interpolated linearly in between
tabulated MF=4 pdfs are projected onto at most 64 Legendre coefficients by 64-point Gauss quadrature, rounded to 6 digits (4538-4546)
laboratory-to-centre-of-mass conversion of coefficients is not coded
the angle integral of the damage function is a fixed 64-point Gauss-Legendre rule over the Legendre series

exact_elastic.energy_interpolation: linear pdf mixing between MF=4 energies (INT=2); W linear between the refined points; constant above the last MF=4 energy
